senses.def: A form of autistic echolalia involving the repetition of words or phrases from television.

A time-out taking place during a televised sports match where the game clock is stopped for a period of time to allow for TV commercials to air before the resumption of play. The delay is usually after a whistle or other stoppage of play occurs, and not an interference with gameplay in and of itself.
A tray on which a meal can be informally served for eating while watching television.
A hardware component that allows a computer to receive television signals.
A kind of video terminal that could be used with a standard television set.
